test_cases.path_step: The Teacher returns to the main Dashboard by clicking the 'Back' button, which lists all courses.
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 6: COURSE LIFECYCLE (COURSE DELETION) - Phase 2: Test Course Deletion Process
test_cases.test_case_title: Return to Dashboard from Course Details Page
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher is logged into the system and is currently on the 'Course Details Page' for a course, having just performed an action on that page.
test_cases.expected_result: The Teacher is successfully navigated back to the 'Dashboard Page', which displays a list of all courses. The 'Course Details Page' is no longer visible.
test_cases.post_condition: The Teacher is on the 'Dashboard Page', viewing the list of courses.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Back Button' on the 'Course Details Page' to return to the Dashboard.
